source: Pinned public PyTorch ATen cpu_avg_pool2d_backward<float>, AvgPoolKernel.cpp:349-414, with AveragePool2d.cpp zero initialization
adaptation: Scalar C transliteration of public average-pooling backward with window=stride=2, no padding and floor output shape. The input extents 2*O+R with checked R in {0,1} encode odd tails without an unchecked shape promise. Array delinearization and independent-slice serialization preserve the upstream scatter. Bound to real cudnnPoolingBackward, whose proprietary implementation is validated separately.

specs.name: aten_avg_pool2d_backward_k2_f32
assumptions: Disjoint finite FP32 arrays with positive S,O0,O1, remainders R0,R1 each in {0,1}, and int32-representable tensor strides
Window and stride both (2,2), padding zero, floor output shape, average include-padding mode, no divisor override
deviations: Specialize the public library configuration to a nonoverlapping two-element window in every spatial axis; tensor dimensions remain dynamic.

Retain the public reference channels=S scalar, expose its flattened spatial indexing as contiguous slice/spatial arrays, and serialize the independent-slice parallel_for. The adapter uses cuDNN N=S,C=1.
Remove min/max clipping and divisor branches using the checked input=2*output+remainder extent relation.
